about/index.html.content: About Me Professional Summary I am a software architect based in Tübingen, Germany, with a background in computer science (PhD, Summa Cum Laude) and over seven years of experience building embedded resimulation environments that run at scale in cloud-native verification and validation (V&V) platforms for automated driving (AD) at Robert Bosch GmbH. I lead cross-functional agile teams on an organizational and technical level to deliver high quality and AD-certified (ISO-26262) tools for safety-critical automotive software. My approach emphasizes: Reproducibility — deterministic executions, containerized environments, infrastructure as code Scalable architecture — designing systems that grow from prototype to production across heterogeneous environments Tooling mastery — deep customization of development environments for maximum productivity Continuous integration — automated testing and deployment pipelines from day one Cross-domain expertise — bridging scientific computing, cloud infrastructure, and embedded systems What I Bring to a Team Production experience architecting large-scale C++ and Python systems Proven track record coordinating multiple agile teams as a technical lead Fluency in Linux systems engineering and DevOps practices (Github, Kubernetes, Docker, Airflow) Ability to bridge the gap between research/prototyping and production deployment Strong emphasis on developer experience and team productivity tooling Multilingual communication (German, English, Italian, Spanish) Explore Technical Skills Languages, frameworks, build systems, and development tools. Education & Publications Academic background, certifications, publications, patents, and teaching. Contact How to reach me for professional inquiries. technical/wsl.html.snippet: WSL2 Enable WSL2 Setup windows terminal Remove WSL completely Vcxsrv XLaunch setup for vcxsrv Configure X server I found the best way to use the vcxsr...
technical/wsl.html.content: WSL2 Enable WSL2 Setup windows terminal Remove WSL completely Vcxsrv XLaunch setup for vcxsrv Configure X server I found the best way to use the vcxsrv is to use the multi-window mode. Each GUI starts in its own window, it can be resized on-the-fly and they do not interfere with one another in the same window. Use the following command to start vcxsrv in that mode "C:\Program Files\VcXsrv\vcxsrv.exe" :0 -clipboard -ac -multiwindow -wgl :0 Display number clipboard Enable clipboard sharing between host and wsl ac Disable access control restrictions so that the wsl client can connect to the server wgl Enable GLX extension For details, check the command line options of vcxsrv . Author: Fabian Franzelin Email: fabian.franzelin@gmail.com Created: 2026-09-18 Fri 22:41
